title: Vermont AI Laws

reading.body:
Vermont's only AI-related law is a narrow election rule, not a framework for AI development or deployment.

The law, S0023, passed on 2026-03-10, targets synthetic media that is deceptive and fraudulent when published within 90 days before an election. It requires disclosure in formats specific to images, video, and audio, gives the Attorney General and State's Attorneys enforcement and investigation powers, allows candidates to seek injunctive relief, and penalizes knowing and intentional violations. That is the entire scope of what Vermont has enacted.

For AI specifically, this is a content and speech rule, not a compute, building, or power rule. It governs what a system may publish near an election and how that publication must be labeled. It places no requirement on data centers, electricity supply, model training, or chip procurement, so it does not touch the constraints that shape where and whether AI capacity gets built.

The data covers one law and nothing else. It does not say whether Vermont considered other AI bills, whether any failed, or what agencies are doing without legislation. A single enacted law is not a measure of state AI policy, and this one should not be read as Vermont regulating AI as an industry.

Vermont has enacted 1 AI-related law. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Vermont

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • S0023: An act relating to the use of synthetic media in elections passed 2026-03-10

    This act requires a disclosure on synthetic media that is deceptive and fraudulent when published, communicated, or distributed within 90 days before an election in Vermont. It sets specific format requirements for the disclosure in images, video, and audio, and provides penalties for knowing and intentional violations. It also gives enforcement and investigation powers to the Attorney General and State's Attorneys, and allows candidates to seek injunctive relief.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Vermont. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
